purpose: Address strongest alternative: pre-folded ordinary independent/tied expert weights may be faster than runtime Mirror while costing more resident bytes. First experiment must not be revised by this follow-up.
scientific_question: At K=4 and K=5, compare precomputed per-view folded ordinary FFN (matmul->GELU->matmul) with packed shared-preactivation Mirror, duplicated unreduced full, and exact output-only readout. Track physical RAM bytes and actual serialized NPZ cost.
hypothesis: Pre-folded experts may achieve lower P95 inference latency than runtime Givens Mirror at larger resident RAM; a mere reduction in matrix MACs does not guarantee a faster eager kernel.
math_spec: For row-vector convention f_m(x)=Wdown * Qm^{-1} GELU(Qm Wup x) adjusted to row orientation: z=x@Wup; y=GELU(z@Tm) @ (Tm^-1@Wdown); folded U_m=Wup@Tm, D_m=Tm^-1@Wdown.
dataset: Frozen random weights, no training, batch 16/128, din=64 hidden=256 dout=64, K in {4,5} independently seeded worlds; full function equivalence checked FP32 max abs <=3e-5 before timing.
compared: folded independent per-view matrices precomputed offline/at load, both packed and loop
storage: Serialize same named NPZ shared weights+angles versus per-role Wup_folded/Wdown_folded using float32, header and metadata in actual npz bytes; report tensor RAM bytes separately.

decision.PASS_mechanism: exact folded predictions match runtime Mirror <=3e-5 every world; indicate Pareto CPU milliseconds vs NPZ/RAM bytes
decision.FAIL_Mirror_specific: If pre-folded or ordinary factorized cache dominates Mirror performance on same task quality and physical resident constraints, reject Mirror-specific runtime claim.
decision.UNCERTAIN: No real GPU, fused kernels, transfer measurements or natural specialist quality; this is a CPU speed/size tradeoff.

notes: Do not pool fresh seed 201-205 with earlier 101-105 as preplanned joint confirmatory audit; report independent follow-up control. No status changes to MA-1175/1176.
